info.title: Teletubby capability API
info.description:
The teleprompter that shows and edits scripts. Every client — the prompter window, `bin/teletubby.mjs`, `POST /api/invoke` (snake names) and `POST /api/rpc` (these family.verb names) — calls one seam, `core.invoke`. Port and bearer token: `~/Library/Application Support/teletubby/control.json`. Name yourself in `x-fli-principal: agent:<name>`.

34 methods; 6 are human-only in whole or in part (`x-human-only`) and refused with `forbidden` for agent and cli principals.

Every error carries `data.failureMode` (the canonical name) beside the integer code.

servers.name: loopback
servers.summary: Loopback only; the port and token are in the control file.

methods.name: capabilities.describe
methods.summary: List every capability with its contract, so a caller that has never seen this app can learn it.

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: context.active
methods.summary: What the talent has open right now: set, script, transcript, trigger style, beat. Expires; degrades to {active:false, hint} rather than erroring.

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: context.get
methods.summary: The brand and project Teletubby is currently pointed at, if any — the same shape context_select returns.

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: context.select
methods.summary: Point Teletubby at a brand and project (door 3). Sets the SESSION context only — never written to the store (C2) — and is what list_sets filters by. Refuses and says why rather than falling back to the previous project (C3); a refusal leaves the previous context untouched.

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: context.set-active
methods.summary: Record what the talent has open. UI ONLY — an agent forging the human's selection is a wrong-target bug with no error.

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: pending.approve
methods.summary: Approve a previewed destructive action. UI ONLY — the mechanism that satisfies a control must never be reachable through the surface that control constrains.

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: pending.list
methods.summary: Previewed destructive actions awaiting a human decision. UI ONLY.

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: rig.delete
methods.summary: Remove a saved rig. The arrangement on screen is not disturbed.

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: rig.list
methods.summary: Every saved rig, plus the workspace — the layout the talent last had on screen and the rig it came from.

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: rig.remember-layout
methods.summary: Record the arrangement the talent has on screen, so the next launch opens the way they left it. UI ONLY — an agent that could set it would decide what the talent sees tomorrow.

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: rig.rename
methods.summary: Change a rig’s name without touching its layout. Returns the previous name.

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: rig.save
methods.summary: Create or replace a named rig: which zones are on screen, which one is driven, the camera edge, the text preset. Layout only — never which script or corpus. Returns the previous rig.

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

result.name: result

result.name: result

result.name: result

methods.name: script.update

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: script.write
methods.summary: Add or replace one small NAMED script in the open project from plain text — an intro, a title, a CTA an AI conversation wrote. Optional video tag and caller-authored trigger words. Returns the previous version.

methods.name: set.create
methods.summary: Create an empty script set, optionally attached to a FliHub project (full folder name, verbatim).

params.name: project
params.summary: the FliHub project folder name, VERBATIM and FULL (d01-kybernesis-12-videos) — never a short code; codes are not unique and prefix-resolution picks alphabetically on the FliHub side

schema.description: the FliHub project folder name, VERBATIM and FULL (d01-kybernesis-12-videos) — never a short code; codes are not unique and prefix-resolution picks alphabetically on the FliHub side

result.name: result

methods.name: set.export-to-project
methods.summary: Write a set's data into its project's fli.tubby.json (W6). Requires the open context to match the set's project. Never deletes the app-store copy — it is marked exportedTo instead, so a caller reading the store directly is not misled into thinking it is still live.

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: set.get

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: set.list
methods.summary: The script sets available — the set is the unit, not the script. Filtered to the open project once a context is set (pass allSets to see everything).

params.name: allSets
params.summary: show every set, ignoring the open project context

schema.description: show every set, ignoring the open project context

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: set.rename
methods.summary: Change a set’s TITLE, and/or ATTACH an unattached set to its FliHub project. Never changes an attached project — that is a move, not a rename, and moves are not built.

params.name: project
params.summary: ATTACH only — null→value backfills an unattached set (full folder name, verbatim); changing an attached project is refused: that is a move, not a rename, and moves are not built

schema.description: ATTACH only — null→value backfills an unattached set (full folder name, verbatim); changing an attached project is refused: that is a move, not a rename, and moves are not built

result.name: result
